'''Gold Eight''' was the callsign of [[Gara Petothel]] while she was training as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>
